# freshdesk_contact_field (Resource)

A field on the contact form.

-> `agents_can_edit`, `displayed_for_agents`, `quick_add_for_agent` and `unique` require the newer Contacts and Companies experience.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) Label shown to agents.
- `type` (String) Field type, for example `custom_text`, `custom_dropdown` or `custom_date`. Changing it forces a new field.

### Optional

- `agents_can_edit` (Boolean) Whether agents may edit the field.
- `choices` (Attributes List) Options of a dropdown field, in the order they are shown. Only meaningful for the `custom_dropdown` and `nested_field` types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--choices))
- `customers_can_edit` (Boolean) Whether customers may edit the field in the portal.
- `displayed_for_agents` (Boolean) Whether the field appears in the agent interface.
- `displayed_for_customers` (Boolean) Whether the field appears in the customer portal.
- `editable_in_signup` (Boolean) Whether customers may set the field when signing up.
- `label_for_customers` (String) Label shown in the customer portal.
- `position` (Number) Position of the field on the form.
- `quick_add_for_agent` (Boolean) Whether the field appears in the quick-add contact form.
- `required_for_agents` (Boolean) Whether agents must fill the field in.
- `required_for_customers` (Boolean) Whether customers must fill the field in.
- `unique` (Boolean) Whether values must be unique across contacts, which prevents duplicates.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the field was created (RFC 3339).
- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is a built-in field rather than a custom one.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the field.
- `name` (String) Internal name Freshdesk generated for the field.
- `updated_at` (String) When the field was last changed (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--choices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `choices`

Required:

- `value` (String) Stored value of the choice.

Optional:

- `label` (String) Label shown for the choice. Defaults to `value`.
- `position` (Number) Position of the choice in the dropdown.

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the choice.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import freshdesk_contact_field.example 42
```
